description: Ex-USAF 60-0102, FACh T-37B 392, mounted on a plinth on Avenida O'Higgins, San Felipe. In August 2018 the municipality approved the Club Aéreo de San Felipe's request to move it to the Víctor Lafón aerodrome as the start of an open-air museum (tallyho.cl); whether the move happened is unconfirmed.
museum_name: Avenida O'Higgins T-37 Monument, San Felipe
